methodology.timed: For every fresh copy: canonical source reads and original writeAttribute bridge, versus native snapshot preparation plus native initialization. No snapshot reuse outside timing. Source/destination allocation, complete output verification, release and asynchronous major GC excluded.

limitations: Data-copy microbenchmark on one machine using the same addon for both paths. Does not include DOM wrappers/factories/hooks, parsing, Jest/Vitest or public cloneNode/importNode. Cannot resolve the clone controller checkpoint budget or establish full DOM speed.
